headline: Paramount completes $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery, forming Skydance
summary: The historic $110 billion deal unites major film studios, TV networks, and streaming services under the new Skydance banner, overcoming antitrust hurdles and competition.
details: Paramount has officially completed its $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, creating a new media giant named Skydance. This merger brings together major film studios, TV networks, and brands like HBO, CBS News, and CNN under one roof.

The path to this megamerger was challenging, with Paramount facing a months-long battle against Netflix for WBD and criticism over media consolidation. Lawmakers and Hollywood talent expressed concerns about its potential negative impact.

A key hurdle was cleared last month after settling with 12 states that had filed antitrust lawsuits. As part of the agreement, Skydance must release a minimum of 30 theatrical films in each of the first two years and increase US production spending by at least $300 million annually.

David Ellison will co-lead Skydance alongside Ynon Kreiz, the former chairman and CEO of Mattel. Ellison stated the ambition was to create a stronger competitor with broad reach to tell diverse stories on every platform.

headline_marked: [[Mistral launches 'Le Chonk']], a 1-trillion parameter open-weight AI model
headline: Mistral launches 'Le Chonk', a 1-trillion parameter open-weight AI model
summary: The new 1-trillion parameter model, also known as Mistral Large 4, is optimized for coding, cyberdefense, and other niche industries, aiming to compete with top proprietary models.
details: French company Mistral has released its new 1-trillion parameter open-weight AI model, Mistral Large 4, nicknamed "Le Chonk." This model is freely available for anyone to use and customize, with a preview version out now and a final release expected by month-end.

Le Chonk is built to compete with leading general-purpose models, specifically optimized for coding, cyberdefense, manufacturing, finance, and electrical engineering. Mistral aims to address areas less focused on by other major AI labs.

Mistral positions Le Chonk as the most capable open-weight model developed outside of China, claiming it is "very, very close" to some proprietary models. The company states it trained this model from scratch, avoiding distillation methods used by some Chinese labs.

Open-weight models offer significant cost advantages for businesses, only incurring compute expenses. Mistral believes Le Chonk's competitive performance will eliminate remaining hesitations for businesses considering open-source alternatives.

The release comes amid mounting tensions over AI access, with US restrictions on models from OpenAI and Anthropic creating an opening for European open-weight labs. This geopolitical context highlights the strategic importance of models like Le Chonk.

Mistral emphasizes that owning the model provides crucial security, as reliance on closed proprietary models carries the risk of sudden access revocation. This applies to companies globally, not just those outside the US.
